projects.title: Automated Data Pipeline with Statistical Monitoring
projects.description: ETL pipeline with CDC fact tables, 3σ anomaly detection, and automated alerting
projects.longDescription: Designed an ETL pipeline to automate biweekly data ingestion from a centralized platform into a cloud data warehouse. Implemented a change-data-capture Fact table for daily delta logging and audit trails. Built a statistical anomaly detection layer using 3-standard-deviation thresholds (99.96% confidence intervals) to proactively flag data quality issues across key metrics. Integrated automated alarming mechanisms that trigger alerts when metrics breach threshold boundaries, enabling rapid incident response. Architected a solution balancing automated scheduling with manual override capabilities via a self-service data platform.

projects.title: Macro Optimizer — Market Classification Engine
projects.description: 2×2 quadrant classification ranking markets by growth, opportunity, and revenue maturity
projects.longDescription: Consolidated 9 data sources into a unified country-level analytical dataset and applied a 2×2 quadrant classification framework ranking markets by opportunity size, growth trajectory, and revenue maturity. Business leaders used the output to prioritize geographic investments, shifting budget allocation from historical patterns to data-driven market potential scoring across awareness, consideration, conversion, and loyalty funnel stages.

projects.title: Investment Analyzer — Marketing Channel Allocation & ROI Forecasting
projects.description: Interactive calculator for modeling channel spend scenarios and forecasting ROI outcomes
projects.longDescription: Built an interactive forecasting tool that enables users to model marketing channel investment scenarios and predict return on investment outcomes. The calculator ingests geo-level data mapped from 5+ source tables and lets stakeholders adjust spend inputs across channels to forecast pipeline, conversion, and revenue impact. Used to inform how $XXX million in marketing spend was allocated across channels and regions, shifting decisions from intuition-based to model-driven forecasting.

projects.title: Incrementality Measurement — Treatment/Control Framework
projects.description: Quasi-experimental framework that greenlit reallocation of $XX million in channel spend
projects.longDescription: Designed and executed an incrementality study to measure causal program impact by constructing treatment and control cohorts from targeted vs. non-targeted domains and accounts. Defined holdout groups, established baseline metrics, and calculated lift by comparing conversion rates and pipeline outcomes between cohorts. The results were used to greenlight the reallocation of $XX million in spend from underperforming channels to higher-converting ones. Performed entity resolution to link records across disparate ID systems, improving match rates to near-complete coverage to ensure statistical validity of the treatment/control comparison. Delivered reporting tables with cohort-level breakdowns feeding self-service BI dashboards for ongoing program evaluation.

projects.title: Ad Spend Deduplication — Data Quality & Statistical Correction
projects.description: Identified systematic metric inflation and implemented window-function deduplication
projects.longDescription: Identified systematic data duplication inflating metrics through exploratory data analysis. Implemented a proportional distribution algorithm using SQL window functions (PARTITION BY / ROW_NUMBER) to deduplicate records while preserving metric integrity across creative units.
